indicator_name: World Development Indicators (World Bank), Kazakhstan — every series
description: Показатели мирового развития (WDI, Всемирный банк) по Казахстану — все ряды
unit: as named in item_name (WDI indicator; unit in parentheses)
methodology: item_code = WDI code (NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG, SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS, SI.POV.GINI …), item_name = its English name with the unit. Only non-empty values; 1960 onward. Many WDI series for Kazakhstan are IMF/ILO/UN estimates, not national statistics — check the WDI source note before using one instead of a BNS series.
